text:
Amr Moussa, Arab League Secretary-General from 2001 to 2011, sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar from the Arab Creativity Union in Egypt. The award went to Kuwaiti Qari Mishary Alafasy, and the Wikipedia entry on [Mishari bin Rashid Alafasy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mishari_bin_Rashid_Alafasy) dates it to 25 October 2008. Only that Wikipedia entry names Moussa as sponsor, and I found no second source for that detail, so I rely on it being accurate.

CONFIDENCE: 75
